column1: # Indonesian (id) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource,
# string table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands use the
# base verb ("Simpan Sebagai…", "Tambah Penanda"), messages address the user as "Anda", and menu
# labels keep the title case of the English source. Product, format and technology names
# (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri, ProRes, LUFS, EDL, AAF…) keep their spelling, and common loanwords
# of the trade (render, preset, mixer, gain, ripple, roll, slip, slide, snap, scrub, offline) stay
# as they are. Decimal fractions in descriptions use a comma (29,97 fps). This catalog has the same
# entries as `es.tsv` plus the native macOS Settings menu; strings added later show in English until
# they are translated. A native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = klip, track = trek, sequence = sekuens, timeline = linimasa, bin = bin, playhead =
# kepala putar, In/Out = Masuk / Keluar (titik masuk / titik keluar), marker = penanda, keyframe =
# bingkai kunci, frame = bingkai, frame hold = tahan bingkai, edit point = titik edit, trim =
# pangkas, panel = panel, workspace = ruang kerja, captions = takarir, subtitle = subtitel, proxy =
# proksi, insert = sisipkan, overwrite = timpa, lift = angkat, extract = ekstrak, nest = sarangkan,
# footage = rekaman, waveform = bentuk gelombang, scopes = skop, blur = buram, dissolve = larut,
# wipe = sapuan, glow = pendar, noise = derau, error = galat, file = berkas, guide = garis bantu,
# thumbnail = gambar mini, voice-over = sulih suara, default = bawaan, preferences (also the native
# macOS Settings menu) = Preferensi, settings = pengaturan.
